title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Explore ten distinct study environments across Azusa Pacific University's East and West campuses, from quiet library carrels to vibrant student commons.

cards.title: Marshburn Library 3rd Floor
cards.subtitle: Quiet Study with a View
cards.notes: Head to the north side windows for views of the amphitheater and sunsets. This floor is designated for focused, quiet academic work on East Campus.
cards.short_summary: A quiet study floor on East Campus featuring large windows with views of the Wynn Amphitheater.
cards.evidence_claim: Marshburn Memorial Library's 3rd floor is described as a perfect place for studying with a view, specifically the north side by large windows.
cards.source_title: APU Students' and Alumni's Favorite Spots On Campus
cards.access_notes: Open to students during regular library hours; check the APU Libraries website for current daily schedules.

cards.entity_name: John and Marilyn Duke Student Commons
cards.title: Duke Commons Leisure Pods
cards.subtitle: Modern West Campus Hub
cards.notes: Utilize the specialized leisure pods and booths designed for individual study or small group collaboration near the main entrance.
cards.short_summary: A recently renovated 27,000-square-foot space on West Campus offering comfortable booths and study pods.
cards.evidence_claim: The Duke Student Commons features a variety of booths for meeting and leisure pods conducive to studying.
cards.source_title: APU Opens Revamped Duke Student Commons
cards.access_notes: Accessible to all students; includes dining options and stadium seating for community events.

cards.title: Stamps Library Nooks
cards.subtitle: Secluded West Campus Focus
cards.notes: Find a quiet nook or one of the library's couches for a comfortable, focused session surrounded by theological collections.
cards.short_summary: A specialized library on West Campus known for its quiet, cozy atmosphere and focused study areas.
cards.evidence_claim: Students describe Stamps Library as a place to find a nook to focus and study, often utilizing the quiet couches.
cards.source_title: APU Students' and Alumni's Favorite Spots On Campus
cards.access_notes: Located on West Campus; check library hours for specific access times for theological research and study.

cards.title: Segerstrom Atrium
cards.subtitle: Light-Filled Academic Space
cards.notes: Study in the open atrium where glass channels provide natural light throughout the day. Ideal for science students between labs.
cards.short_summary: A modern atrium on West Campus featuring natural lighting and proximity to science laboratories.
cards.evidence_claim: The Segerstrom Science Center includes student study and community areas with glass channels that distribute daylight.
cards.source_title: Centers - Humanities and Sciences - Azusa Pacific University
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours; houses the Center for Research in Science and various teaching labs.

cards.title: Wynn Amphitheater Steps
cards.subtitle: Outdoor Terraced Study
cards.notes: Use the terraced grass steps for outdoor reading or group discussion. Located conveniently between Wynn Academic Center and Wilden Hall.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor terraced seating area on East Campus used for study, reflection, and community gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: The terraced seating in the Amphitheater is used by students to study between classes and enjoy the outdoors.
cards.source_title: 10 Places to Relax on the APU Campus
cards.access_notes: Public outdoor space on East Campus; accessible 24/7, though best used during daylight hours.

cards.title: Darling Library Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Reservable Group Spaces
cards.notes: Book a room online for group projects. These spaces in the Ahmanson Center wing provide a private environment for collaboration.
cards.short_summary: Private study rooms located within the Darling Library on West Campus, available by reservation.
cards.evidence_claim: Darling Library offers reservable study rooms, specifically in the Ahmanson Center zone.
cards.access_notes: Reservations are typically required through the LibCal system; check for specific room capacities.

cards.title: Cougar Dome Lounge
cards.subtitle: Commuter-Friendly Study
cards.notes: A lively spot for commuters to study between classes. Features comfortable lounge seating and a social atmosphere on East Campus.
cards.short_summary: A multi-purpose student lounge on East Campus that serves as a study and social hub for commuters.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cougar Dome is described as a great place to study and a home away from home for commuters.
cards.source_title: APU Students' and Alumni's Favorite Spots On Campus
cards.access_notes: Located on the south side of Cougar Walk; open during standard campus building hours.

cards.title: Hartwig Prayer Chapel
cards.subtitle: Silent Reflection Space
cards.notes: A 24-hour quiet sanctuary for silent study and reflection. Maintain a respectful volume in this intimate East Campus space.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour chapel on East Campus providing a silent and intimate environment for prayer and quiet thought.
cards.evidence_claim: Hartwig Prayer Chapel is a 24-hour place of quiet prayer and reflection adjacent to Smith Hall.
cards.source_title: 10 Places to Relax on the APU Campus
cards.access_notes: Accessible 24 hours a day for students seeking a silent environment.

cards.title: Marshburn Main Floor Rooms
cards.subtitle: Collaborative Group Rooms
cards.notes: Reserve one of the group study rooms on the main floor for team meetings. These rooms are equipped for collaborative academic work.
cards.short_summary: Reservable group study rooms located on the main floor of Marshburn Library on East Campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Marshburn Library offers reservable study and meeting rooms on the main floor through the LibCal system.
cards.access_notes: Reservations are recommended; check the library website for current availability and booking rules.

cards.title: Mary Hill Garden
cards.subtitle: Peaceful Outdoor Nook
cards.notes: Find a stone or bench in this garden between the Felix Event Center and Mary Hill Building for a quiet outdoor study break.
cards.short_summary: A peaceful prayer garden on West Campus offering a quiet atmosphere with views of a flower wall and cross.
cards.evidence_claim: The Mary Hill garden is described as a quiet, peaceful atmosphere for taking a breath or studying between classes.
cards.source_title: APU Students' and Alumni's Favorite Spots On Campus
cards.access_notes: Outdoor garden space accessible to students throughout the day on West Campus.
